# Social Media Marketing for Accountants and CPAs Stay Visible Online with Done-for-You Facebook and LinkedIn Management

Our social media marketing services help accounting firms stay active online, strengthen credibility, and drive traffic back to their websites. We create and post 3 articles and 1 video every month to your LinkedIn and Facebook company pages — while also helping set up or optimize your profiles for better visibility.

![Outsourced social media marketing](/images/placeholder.png)

## Social Media Management for Accountants

As an accountant, managing social media may not be your expertise — but maintaining an active online presence matters. That’s why Build Your Firm offers social media management for accounting firms as part of our Content Marketing in a Box program.

We help CPA firms use Facebook and LinkedIn consistently with professionally managed content, strategic posting, and optimized company pages designed to support your broader online marketing efforts.

### Social Media Marketing Done For You

Our done-for-you service gives your firm a consistent social media presence without adding work to your plate.

Each month we:

*   Post **3 accounting or tax articles and 1 engaging video**
    
*   Share content to your Facebook and LinkedIn company pages
    
*   Drive visitors back to your website through article links
    
*   Keep your firm active and visible with prospects year-round
    

With our Content Marketing in a Box program, we handle the writing, posting, and content management while you stay focused on clients.

[Learn More About Content Marketing in a Box](https://www.buildyourfirm.com/marketing/content-marketing-in-a-box) [FREE Information Kit](https://forms.buildyourfirm.com/infokit)

![Outsourced social media marketing](/images/placeholder.png)

## LinkedIn and Facebook Setup and Optimization

Getting your social media profiles set up correctly is the first step. Whether you need pages created from scratch or existing profiles improved, we help optimize your presence on both platforms.

A properly built and optimized profile helps reinforce credibility when prospects research your firm online.

You'll receive:

*   LinkedIn Company Page setup or optimization
    
*   Facebook Business Page setup or optimization
    
*   Branded cover images and graphics
    
*   Optimized About sections and company descriptions
    
*   Consistent branding across both profiles
    

![Outsourced social media marketing](/images/placeholder.png)

## Facebook and LinkedIn Posting for Accountants

Social media works best when it stays active with useful, relevant content.

Each month we post:

*   Tax and accounting articles that drive traffic back to your website
    
*   Educational and engaging videos that reinforce your expertise
    
*   Content designed to keep your audience informed and connected
    

This steady stream of posting helps keep your firm visible on Facebook and LinkedIn without requiring you to manage it yourself.

### Sample accounting videos we post:

[Example Video 1](https://www.buildyourfirm.com/marketing/content-marketing-in-a-box/social-media-for-accountants#) [Example Video 2](https://www.buildyourfirm.com/marketing/content-marketing-in-a-box/social-media-for-accountants#)

![Outsourced social media marketing](/images/placeholder.png)

## Free White Paper: How Accounting Firms Get Found in Google and AI Search

If your firm isn’t showing up where prospects are searching today, you’re missing opportunities.

This guide breaks down how to:

*   Improve visibility in AI and Google search
    
*   Strengthen your local presence
    
*   Build authority with content
    
*   Turn reviews into new business
    

Get instant access and start generating more qualified leads.

[Download Your Free Whitepaper](https://www.buildyourfirm.com/social-media-for-accountants-white-paper)

![content marketing services](/images/placeholder.png)

## Content Marketing in a Box for Accountants

At Build Your Firm, social media management is part of our broader **Content Marketing in a Box** program designed specifically for accountants and CPA firms.

Rather than treating social media as a standalone service, we use it as part of a coordinated strategy to help distribute content, drive traffic back to your website, and reinforce your firm’s expertise online.

Find out how **Content Marketing in a Box** can help your firm combine website design, advanced SEO and AI visibility, local search optimization, generate reviews, and social media management into one complete online marketing program.

[Learn More About Content Marketing in a Box](https://www.buildyourfirm.com/marketing/content-marketing-in-a-box) [Free Information Kit](https://forms.buildyourfirm.com/infokit)

## Frequently Asked Questions About Social Media for Accounting Firms

*   ### 1. What social media platforms should accountants use?
    
    For most accounting firms, Facebook and LinkedIn are two of the most effective platforms. LinkedIn helps support professional visibility and referral networking, while Facebook can help firms stay connected with prospects and clients. Our service focuses on managing both platforms for accountants and CPA firms.
    
*   ### 2. Do accountants need a LinkedIn company page?
    
    Yes. A LinkedIn Company Page can help strengthen your online presence, reinforce credibility, and provide another place prospects can learn about your firm. If you do not have a LinkedIn page, we can set one up for you, or we can optimize your existing page
    
*   ### 3. Do accountants need a Facebook Business Page?
    
    A Facebook Business Page can help support your firm’s visibility and provide another channel to share helpful content with prospects and clients. We can create a new Facebook page for your firm or optimize one you already have.
    
*   ### 4. How often should accountants post on social media?
    
    Consistency matters more than posting constantly. For many accounting firms, regular monthly posting is an effective approach. Our program includes posting 3 articles and 1 video each month to keep your Facebook and LinkedIn pages active and professional.
    
*   ### 5. Do you create social media content for accountants each month?
    
    Yes. We create and post 3 accounting or tax articles and 1 engaging video every month to your Facebook and LinkedIn company pages, helping keep your firm visible and your content fresh.
